purpose: Deterministic checklist for reviewing a proposed Lagos field site before any physical installation or collection.

required_evidence.name: Site/access authorization
required_evidence.acceptance: Current document identifies authorized site/scope and responsible authority.

required_evidence.name: Installation permission
required_evidence.acceptance: Collector installation is expressly permitted within the authorized scope.

required_evidence.name: Field safety assessment
required_evidence.acceptance: Hazards, controls, emergency procedure and responsible operator are recorded.

required_evidence.name: Sampling/laboratory readiness
required_evidence.acceptance: Sample handling, laboratory recipient and applicable methods are defined before collection.

required_evidence.name: Data/security/privacy boundary
required_evidence.acceptance: Public/restricted data handling and sensitive-location treatment are defined.

required_evidence.name: Location verification
required_evidence.acceptance: Survey evidence and independent GIS cross-check exist; exact coordinates remain restricted where required.

required_evidence.name: Collector readiness
required_evidence.acceptance: Controlled apparatus, first-flush control, sealed container, measurement and time controls are ready.

required_evidence.name: Rain-event readiness
required_evidence.acceptance: Qualified observation source, event criteria and antecedent-rainfall procedure are defined.

independent_check.rule: The same person cannot be treated as the sole authorization, field operator and independent reviewer for a material gate.

release_rule: S6C.1 acceptance permits progression to controlled field preparation only. It does not itself authorize a rain-event collection.
